title: DailyTen｜今天值得知道的十件事

items.title: OpenAI 不再直接用“活着的互联网”训练：及时性要让位给安全
items.brief: 以后 AI 未必会立刻吸收网上的新内容，换来的是少一点被恶意网页带偏的风险。
items.take: OpenAI 表示，将不再让模型直接在实时互联网内容上训练，理由是风险显著。核心麻烦不只是错误信息：公开网页可以被操纵，恶意内容也可能借训练过程影响模型行为。对用户来说，AI 回答“刚刚发生什么”时，可能更依赖检索、授权数据和后续更新，而不是把全网新页面直接吃进去。安全边界更清楚了，但信息新鲜度、开放网络与模型能力之间的取舍也会更明显。

en.title: OpenAI steps back from training on the live web: freshness gives way to safety
en.brief: AI may no longer absorb new web content immediately, in exchange for less risk of malicious pages steering it off course.
en.take: OpenAI says it will no longer train its models directly on live internet content, citing significant risks. The issue is not just misinformation: public webpages can be manipulated, and hostile content could influence model behavior through training. For users, answers about what just happened may rely more on search, licensed data, and later updates rather than a model simply ingesting the newest pages online. The safety boundary is clearer, but the trade-off between freshness, an open web, and model capability is now harder to ignore.

Safety controls may take priority over instant web ingestion

items.title: OpenAI 把“会做决定”的模型推向大众：AI 不只聊天，开始替你选下一步
items.brief: 更会规划的 AI 可能让复杂任务少点来回，但它做错一步，后面的连锁错误也会更贵。
items.take: OpenAI 据报道已更广泛提供一款与 Jev 竞争的决策模型。与只生成一段回答的聊天模型相比，决策模型更强调在多步任务中判断先后、权衡选项和持续执行。它的吸引力很直接：写代码、整理工作流、处理客服或安排事务时，用户少盯几步。但当模型被允许替人作选择，错误也不再只是“一句答错”，而可能变成下错订单、改错设置或把任务带偏。真正的竞争将是能力、价格和权限控制谁先做稳。

en.title: OpenAI broadens access to a decision model: AI is moving from chat to choosing the next step
en.brief: Better-planning AI could cut the back-and-forth in complex work, but one bad move can make every later mistake costlier.
en.take: OpenAI has reportedly made a decision model, positioned against Jev, more widely available. Unlike a chat model that mainly produces an answer, a decision model is meant to choose an order of actions, weigh options, and continue through a multi-step task. The appeal is obvious in coding, workflow management, customer service, and scheduling: people may need to supervise fewer steps. But once a model is allowed to make choices, failure is no longer just a wrong sentence; it can mean a wrong order, a changed setting, or an entire task sent in the wrong direction. The real contest will be over capability, price, and reliable permission controls.

items.title: 数据中心越建越大，附近居民先看到的是噪音、电网和水费压力
items.brief: AI 服务看起来在云端，账单和施工却可能先落在数据中心周边社区。
items.take: BBC 报道称，围绕大型数据中心的反对声音正在增长。对科技公司而言，它们是训练和运行 AI 的基础设施；对附近居民而言，感受更具体：施工、柴油备用发电机噪音、用水需求，以及电网容量是否被优先占用。数据中心不必然是坏事，也会带来投资和部分岗位，但它们常被宣传为“无形的云”，实际却是高耗电的大型工业设施。未来项目能否拿到许可，越来越取决于能否公开说明电力、水和社区补偿怎么安排。

en.title: Data centers keep growing; nearby residents get the noise, grid strain, and water worries
en.brief: AI may feel like it lives in the cloud, but construction and utility costs can land first in communities near data centers.
en.take: The BBC reports growing pushback against large data centers. For technology companies, they are the physical base for training and running AI. For nearby residents, the effects are more tangible: construction, noise from diesel backup generators, water demand, and concern that grid capacity is being claimed first. Data centers can bring investment and some jobs, but the supposedly weightless cloud is in fact a power-hungry industrial facility. Whether new projects win approval will increasingly depend on clear answers about electricity, water, and what communities receive in return.

items.title: 欧洲天然气升至四年高位：冬天还没到，取暖和工业成本已在抬头
items.brief: 中东供应担忧推高欧洲气价，家庭账单未必立刻上涨，但冬季缓冲变薄了。
items.take: 欧洲天然气价格因冬季供应忧虑升至四年高位，报道将中东局势带来的风险列为重要背景。天然气价格不是每个家庭账单的即时复制品，零售合同、政府补贴和库存都会缓冲一段时间；但如果高价持续，供暖、发电和高耗能制造业都会感到压力。欧洲这些年努力减少对单一来源的依赖，却仍会被全球液化天然气货运和地缘冲突牵动。真正要看的是冬季库存能撑多久，以及是否再出现运输中断。

en.title: European gas hits a four-year high: winter heating and factory costs are already under pressure
en.brief: Middle East supply fears have lifted European gas prices; household bills may not jump today, but the winter cushion is thinner.
en.take: European gas prices have reached a four-year high amid worries about winter supply, with Middle East risk a major backdrop in the report. Wholesale gas prices do not instantly become household bills: retail contracts, subsidies, and storage can soften the first blow. But if elevated prices persist, heating, electricity generation, and energy-intensive manufacturing all face pressure. Europe has worked to reduce reliance on any one supplier, yet it remains exposed to global liquefied natural gas cargoes and geopolitical disruption. The key question is how long storage lasts through winter and whether transport is interrupted again.

items.title: 卢拉赢得巴西第四任期：拉美最大经济体没有向极右转弯
items.brief: 巴西选民让卢拉继续执政，接下来市场和盟友都要看他能否把胜选变成稳定治理。
items.take: 多家媒体报道，卢拉在巴西总统选举中击败弗拉维奥·博索纳罗，赢得历史性的第四个任期。这不仅是一场国内政党轮替：巴西是拉美最大经济体，也是农业、矿产、气候谈判和金砖合作的重要参与者。选举结果让左翼路线延续，但并不等于政策可以畅通无阻；国会力量、财政空间和社会分裂仍会限制新政府。对外界而言，接下来要看的不是庆祝场面，而是亚马孙保护、贸易立场和经济治理会怎么落地。

en.title: Lula wins a fourth term: Latin America’s biggest economy has not turned to the far right
en.brief: Brazilian voters kept Lula in office; markets and allies now need to see whether victory becomes stable government.
en.take: Multiple outlets report that Lula defeated Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil’s presidential election, winning a historic fourth term. This is more than a domestic contest: Brazil is Latin America’s largest economy and a major player in agriculture, minerals, climate talks, and BRICS cooperation. The result keeps a left-wing course in place, but it does not guarantee easy governing. Congressional power, fiscal limits, and social division will still constrain the new administration. The next test is not the celebration but the details of Amazon protection, trade policy, and economic management.

items.brief: 长期抗议变成选票结果，新政府与欧盟、俄罗斯之间怎么站队，会影响整个巴尔干。

en.title: Serbia’s student movement unseats Vučić: the Balkan balance must be recalculated
en.brief: Long-running protest has become an election result; the new government’s stance between the EU and Russia matters beyond Serbia.
en.take: The BBC and The Guardian report that Serbian leader Aleksandar Vučić lost a fiercely contested parliamentary election to forces energized by a student-led protest movement. It is a defeat for one leader, but it may shift a more complicated Balkan balance. Serbia has long tried to move closer to the EU while maintaining ties with Russia; the makeup and direction of the new government will show whether that room for ambiguity survives. The fact that student protests became an electoral force also shows how accumulated pressure over living costs, corruption allegations, and trust in institutions can turn into political change.

items.title: 苏丹无人机袭击打向电力设施：战火先让普通人失去照明和供水
items.brief: 东部多州大范围停电，冲突的伤害正从前线延伸到医院、水泵和家庭生活。
items.take: 《卫报》报道，苏丹准军事组织的无人机袭击造成东部多个州大面积停电。电网成为攻击目标时，受影响的不只是工业：医院的备用电源、家庭照明、冷藏药品、通信和供水系统都可能随之承压。无人机让武装组织能以较低门槛打到远离前线的基础设施，也让修复人员面对持续风险。苏丹的人道危机本已严重，停电若拉长，会让流离失所者和依赖公共服务的人先承受代价。

苏丹东部多个州出现大范围停电
电力基础设施成为冲突中的脆弱环节

en.title: Drone strikes hit Sudan’s power system: war first takes away light, water, and basic services
en.brief: Wide outages in eastern states show how conflict is spreading from the front line into hospitals, pumps, and homes.
en.take: The Guardian reports that drone strikes by a Sudanese paramilitary force caused mass power cuts across eastern states. When the grid is hit, the damage is not confined to industry: hospital backup power, household lighting, refrigerated medicines, communications, and water systems all come under strain. Drones give armed groups a relatively accessible way to strike infrastructure far from the front line, while making repairs riskier. Sudan’s humanitarian crisis was already severe; prolonged outages will hit displaced people and those reliant on public services first.

items.title: 乌干达对刚果（金）返国者隔离21天：防疫把边境流动按下暂停键
items.brief: 为防止风险跨境扩散，返国人员要隔离三周，家庭、工作和货运都会被拖慢。
items.take: BBC 报道，乌干达要求从刚果民主共和国返回的本国公民接受21天隔离。隔离是防止潜在传染风险在早期进入社区的直接办法，但代价也很现实：跨境家庭团聚、临时工作、贸易和运输都会被打断。三周的长度通常对应对高风险传染病的观察窗口，但这项措施能否有效，不只看边境是否严格，也取决于隔离期间的生活保障、检测能力和信息透明度。对边境居民来说，公共卫生措施往往就是一笔突然增加的时间和收入成本。
facts: 乌干达对自刚果（金）返国公民实施21天隔离

en.title: Uganda imposes 21-day quarantine for returnees from DR Congo: public health puts border travel on pause
en.brief: To curb cross-border risk, returnees face three weeks in quarantine, slowing family life, work, and freight.
en.take: The BBC reports that Uganda has ordered a 21-day quarantine for its citizens returning from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Quarantine is a direct way to stop a potential infectious threat reaching communities early, but the costs are concrete: family reunions, temporary work, trade, and transport can all be interrupted. Three weeks commonly reflects an observation window for high-risk infectious disease, yet success depends not only on border enforcement but also on living support during isolation, testing capacity, and transparent information. For border communities, a public-health rule can quickly become a sharp cost in time and income.

items.title: 美国麻疹病例超过去年两倍：本可预防的病又在靠漏洞扩散
items.brief: 病例翻倍不是普通的季节波动，疫苗覆盖不够的社区最容易先出现连锁感染。
items.take: NPR 报道，美国麻疹病例已超过去年同期的两倍，疫情仍在扩散。麻疹传染性极强，麻烦在于它并不是“只影响不打疫苗的人”：婴儿、因疾病无法接种者和免疫力较弱的人，都依赖社区整体的高接种率获得保护。病例上升会带来学校通知、接触者追踪和医疗资源压力，也可能打乱旅行及育儿安排。控制它的办法其实很老派——及时接种和快速追踪——但一旦出现免疫缺口，补起来往往比守住更难。

en.title: US measles cases are more than double last year’s: a preventable disease is spreading through gaps
en.brief: This is not ordinary seasonal movement; communities with weak vaccination coverage are most exposed to chains of infection.
en.take: NPR reports that US measles cases are more than double last year’s level and the outbreak is spreading. Measles is highly infectious, and it does not affect only people who skip vaccination: babies, people unable to be vaccinated for medical reasons, and those with weakened immune systems depend on high community coverage too. Rising cases bring school notices, contact tracing, and pressure on health services, and can disrupt travel and childcare plans. The solution is old-fashioned—timely vaccination and rapid tracing—but once immunity gaps open, closing them is much harder than maintaining them.

items.title: 台风“尚帕”已致台湾逾500人受伤，正向中国沿海移动
items.brief: 风暴的危险不只在登陆点，停电、积水和交通中断往往在雨带经过后才集中出现。
items.take: 《卫报》报道，台风“尚帕”在台湾已造成1人死亡、500多人受伤，随后向中国方向移动。台风灾害最容易被低估的部分，是风雨最强时过后仍会持续的影响：山区和城市内涝、断电、道路受损，以及救援资源被分散。对准备经过区域的人来说，最实际的决定是不要只盯“是否登陆”，还要看降雨、风暴潮和地方交通管制。随着台风移动，风险并不会消失，而是转移到下一片人口与基础设施更密集的区域。

en.title: Typhoon Champi has injured more than 500 in Taiwan and is moving toward China
en.brief: The danger is not limited to landfall: outages, flooding, and transport disruption often peak after the rain bands pass through.
en.take: The Guardian reports that Typhoon Champi has killed one person and injured more than 500 in Taiwan before moving toward China. The most underestimated part of a typhoon is what continues after the strongest winds: urban and mountain flooding, power cuts, damaged roads, and stretched emergency services. For people in its path, the practical decision is not to watch only for landfall, but also rainfall, storm surge, and local transport restrictions. As the storm moves, the danger does not vanish; it shifts to the next area of people and infrastructure.
